text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because I've lost so many times, I feel 
like my weaknesses have become crystal 
clear!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: We can win next time! I'll prove it!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Tsuyoshi restarts! Starting tomorrow, it's 
a new training menu to patch up 
weaknesses--!!

Yes! Falling down and getting back up is 
my specialty, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Nobody can stop my growth now—!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—*Cough, cough*! I-I got a bit too 
eager...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Right now...? Oh, I see! You're right!! No 
time like the present!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right!! For now, we're sprinting full 
speed all the way back to the academy~!
